018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.procedure;
019
020import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
021import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
022
023import java.io.IOException;
024import java.util.Optional;
025import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseClassTestRule;
026import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName;
027import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.ColumnFamilyDescriptor;
028import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder;
029import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.SnapshotDescription;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.SnapshotType;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.TableDescriptorBuilder;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MasterTests;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MediumTests;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.Bytes;
035import org.junit.ClassRule;
036import org.junit.Rule;
037import org.junit.Test;
038import org.junit.experimental.categories.Category;
039import org.junit.rules.TestName;
040
041@Category({ MasterTests.class, MediumTests.class })
042public class TestSnapshotProcedureForSnapshotType extends TestSnapshotProcedure {
043
044  @ClassRule
045  public static final HBaseClassTestRule CLASS_RULE =
046    HBaseClassTestRule.forClass(TestSnapshotProcedureForSnapshotType.class);
047
048  @Rule
049  public TestName name = new TestName();
050
051  @Test
052  public void testSnapshotTypeForEnabledTable() throws IOException {
053    TableName tableName = TableName.valueOf(name.getMethodName());
054    String snapshotName = "snapshot_" + name.getMethodName();
055    TableDescriptorBuilder tableDescriptorBuilder = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName);
056    ColumnFamilyDescriptor columnFamilyDescriptor =
057      ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(Bytes.toBytes("info")).build();
058    tableDescriptorBuilder.setColumnFamily(columnFamilyDescriptor);
059    admin.createTable(tableDescriptorBuilder.build());
060
061    assertTrue(admin.tableExists(tableName));
062    assertTrue(admin.isTableEnabled(tableName));
063
064    admin.snapshot(snapshotName, tableName);
065    Optional<SnapshotDescription> optional =
066      admin.listSnapshots().stream().filter(s -> snapshotName.equals(s.getName())).findFirst();
067    SnapshotDescription snapshotDescription = optional.orElseThrow();
068    assertEquals(SnapshotType.FLUSH, snapshotDescription.getType());
069  }
070
071  @Test
072  public void testSnapshotTypeForDisabledTable() throws IOException {
073    TableName tableName = TableName.valueOf(name.getMethodName());
074    String snapshotName = "snapshot_" + name.getMethodName();
075    TableDescriptorBuilder tableDescriptorBuilder = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName);
076    ColumnFamilyDescriptor columnFamilyDescriptor =
077      ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(Bytes.toBytes("info")).build();
078    tableDescriptorBuilder.setColumnFamily(columnFamilyDescriptor);
079    admin.createTable(tableDescriptorBuilder.build());
080    assertTrue(admin.tableExists(tableName));
081    assertTrue(admin.isTableEnabled(tableName));
082
083    admin.disableTable(tableName);
084    assertTrue(admin.isTableDisabled(tableName));
085
086    admin.snapshot(snapshotName, tableName);
087    Optional<SnapshotDescription> optional =
088      admin.listSnapshots().stream().filter(s -> snapshotName.equals(s.getName())).findFirst();
089    SnapshotDescription snapshotDescription = optional.orElseThrow();
090    assertEquals(SnapshotType.DISABLED, snapshotDescription.getType());
091  }
092}
